The repository contains files for a task management application named TaskFlow. Key components include:

- `index.html`: The main single-page application shell.
- `style.css`: Stylesheets with custom styles and variables.
- `app.js`: Contains JavaScript logic, state management, and DOM manipulation.
- `README.md`: Documentation including setup instructions and project details.

The repository also includes a live demo link and instructions for local development.

This repository contains files for a task management application named TaskFlow. The application includes features such as a Kanban board, interactive analytics using HTML5 Canvas, a calendar view, and support for data interoperability through XML and JSON parsing. The main components are:

- `index.html`: The main single-page application shell.
- `style.css`: Stylesheets with custom styles and variables.
- `app.js`: Contains JavaScript logic, state management, and DOM manipulation.

The repository also provides instructions for local development and a live demo link.
what is kanban board and and what are the interactive analytics shown in the project

The Kanban board in this task management application allows for drag-and-drop workflow management with persistent state tracking. It categorizes tasks into columns representing different stages (e.g., "To Do," "In Progress," "Done") and provides visual indicators of the number of tasks in each column.

Interactive analytics shown include custom HTML5 Canvas-based data visualization for tracking completion rates and priority distribution. This allows users to see how tasks are progressing over time and identify any bottlenecks or areas needing attention through dynamic charts and graphs directly on the Kanban board or other views within the application.
